decision_notes: Resolution 0.8 was selected after reviewing WNN clustering from 0.2 through 1.0, cluster-size distributions, cross-resolution membership, and canonical mouse-colon marker programs. Resolution 1.0 produced three additional clusters, but the new subdivisions were not sufficiently distinguished by the reviewed marker panel: one large child population lacked a coherent defining program, the 15/20 subdivision showed limited biological separation, and the 19/23 subdivision created a 34-nucleus cluster without a clearly distinct identity. Resolution 0.8 therefore provides the more parsimonious global representation while preserving the option for lineage-specific subclustering.
